children: Diversified announced definitive agreements to acquire Birch Permian, a transaction expected to increase production by ~35% and Adjusted EBITDA by ~55%.
Acquisition valued at ~ $1.8 billion to purchase Birch Permian Holdings and affiliates, closing expected Q4 2026.
Transaction expected to raise production ~35% (adds ~68 Mboepd) and increase Adjusted EBITDA by ~55% (~$548M annualized).
Pro forma operated gross volumes to reach ~2.5 Bcfepd (~1.6 Bcfepd net); assets are ~96% operated with 480 net wells.
Financing to be led by a ~$1.5B asset-backed securitization arranged with Carlyle, plus customary financing and credit facility liquidity.
Carlyle partnership expanded to pursue up to $10B of potential future PDP acquisition opportunities subject to mutual approvals.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Diversified Announces $1.8B Birch Permian Acquisition to Boost Production ~35% and Adj. EBITDA ~55%
